program_alpha_declaration.s34_C1_disposition: ACCEPT AS-IS. S34 C1 checked this arithmetic and found the 0.50 carry to be conservative disclosure, not an error. S35 states both and names 0.40 as GOVERNING so no future reader mistakes 0.50 for the operative bound.
